nginx-serves-tls-with-the-pair / manifests/ssl_nginx_domain.pp:9-14: the lines declare ssl_base for myservice/myservicename 'nginx', so the pair is /etc/ssl/certs/p8test.nginx.bundle.crt + the key, for nginx; a consumer server block naming both is a fair stand-in for the define's purpose. DERIVATION FAILURE in the mutating design: the effect is only 'cat /run/p8test-ssl/serve.txt', a file the ACTION wrote; the s_client handshake, the certificate count, the CN and the openssl verify are all computed inside the action (probe lines 94-100), so expect is matched against the action's own output, not a read-only observation of its result (same defect as the filesystem_yum 20261118T131226Z FAIL). On the clean node the effect failed only because serve.txt was absent (stderr 'cat: /run/p8test-ssl/serve.txt: No such file or directory'), so the negative control never probed nginx. Fix: the action only writes the server block and reloads; the effect runs the loopback s_client/verify itself
